RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: nemesis
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: A raider who killed or maimed a colonist and escaped comes back into the colony's story.
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.inheritanceMutation: the hunt becomes revenge, carried by the heir

RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: silent press
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: The colony silenced the reporter. The news stops; clues follow; then the outlet sends an envoy.

RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: lost family
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: A colonist has living kin in another faction. Letters come; then the kin is taken captive, and a rescue is possible.
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.inheritanceMutation: the search for the relative passes to the heir

RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: awakened empire
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: The major plot: the Empire wakes, asks the colony's stance, and takes the rim settlement by settlement.

RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: hollow choir
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: The Empire's old enemy (War in Heaven): the Choir wakes, asks the colony's stance, and takes the rim settlement by settlement.

RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: imperial crisis
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: The Empire's war on the colony: probing raids, breaches, psychic assaults, sieges and the final assault.

RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.label: choir crisis
RimChronicles.Game.Plots.PlotTemplateDef.description: The Hollow Choir's war on the colony (War in Heaven): probing swarms, tunnel breaches, the hum, burrowing mechs and the final chorus.
